audit_item: F7 / rollout optional factory summary-path compatibility
finding: rollout() computed len(factory.rows) unconditionally even when the caller requested the normal account-row report. The report factory interface does not require rows; generic mock/adapter factories failed before environment creation. After making the row-count read lazy, the fixture also exposed that the current native report contract requires an explicit contract_multiplier.
change: Compute selected_steps from factory.rows only for the no-account-rows, non-spooled online summary path. Other report paths no longer access rows. The test factory now declares contract_multiplier=Decimal("1") to satisfy the explicit contract used by native accounting.
